reporting-org.narrative: Netherlands Advisory Board on Impact Investing

description.narrative:
Dutch impact investors finance sustainable projects across Africa and other emerging markets, while the NAB drives ecosystem-building initiatives. Through strategic collaboration with GSG National Partners (NPs), the NAB strengthens impact investing ecosystems by enhancing local capacity and facilitating ecosystem mapping. These efforts channel Dutch capital toward high-impact opportunities while systematically addressing local market barriers.
About the program
In 2024, the NAB strengthened its engagement with Dutch impact investors and GSG Impact Partners in Africa (NPs), undertaking -a diagnostic study to assess the key challenges both groups face in scaling impact investing. This initiative provided in-depth insights into the structural and financial barriers to increasing capital flows into high-impact sectors such as renewable energy, financial inclusion, and sustainable agriculture. -a Webinar to disseminate the findings -two African GSG Impact Partners were funded to develop their local impact investing ecosystems, further reinforcing the link between Dutch and African stakeholders.
